premises.text: In-venue, naming a manager ally and showing social reach/influence creates pressure to resolve problems on the spot
premises.evidence_span: I have a very important ally to help me get my problem resolved

premises.text: Start a Gripe captures what happened, photos, and a concrete ask so every complaint aims at resolution
premises.evidence_span: the idea is to take every gripe and have it be resolved

premises.text: Gripes go public to followers/Facebook/Twitter and grow virally via permanent URLs and social forwarding
premises.evidence_span: the gripe is sent to your followers and your friends on Facebook and Twitter

premises.text: Merchants get emailed about the public gripe, can claim the account, and resolve knowing the customer's ask
premises.evidence_span: we go back to the merchants and we send them an email saying, hey, this is a gripe

premises.text: Marking a gripe resolved turns links/screens green, converting detractors into positive public outcomes
premises.evidence_span: when the customer marks the gripe as resolved, the top of this screen becomes green

domains.name: consumer gripe capture and social leverage

value.text: Get complaints resolved—turn unhappy customers into happy ones

secondary_value.evidence_span: never really get the respect we deserve as we walk around in the real world

causal_links.evidence_span: take every gripe and have it be resolved
make complainers into customers, and customers into happy customers

notes: Transcript begins mid-demo (truncated). In-venue ally path and Start-a-Gripe path are two surfaces of one complaint-resolution mechanism but kept as distinct failable steps under tie-break (confrontational vs remote). Social viral expansion folded with gripe publish. Merchant email+resolve+green flip are B2B resolution cascade split into notify vs reputation outcome. Closing clout pitch as secondary_value not premise (§4.1.4).
